name: NexusRPG
summary:
NexusRPG is a persistent text-based browser MMORPG in which players develop a lasting character through combat, gathering, crafting and trade. Main-hand and off-hand equipment determine the character's class, while stat allocation, crafted gear and Gems in permanent equipment sockets shape the build. Personal and clan dungeons retain progress between sessions.

Players can develop shared Clan Capitals in Heaven and Hell, lend equipment and Pets through a Clan Armory, and take part in personal and Clan Rifts. Pets can be fed, bred, assigned work or used in combat. The shared world also includes a player Market, world bosses and PvP arenas.
